crossRefs.note: The flesh of the sacrifice of his peace offerings for thanksgiving shall be eaten on the day of his offering. He shall…
If it is eaten at all on the third day, it is an abomination. It will not be accepted;
Moses said to them, “Let no one leave of it until the morning.”
Notwithstanding they didn’t listen to Moses, but some of them left of it until the morning, so it bred worms and became…

translations.web: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am Yahweh.
translations.bsb: It must be eaten that same day. Do not leave any of it until morning. I am the LORD.
translations.kjv: On the same day it shall be eaten up; ye shall leave none of it until the morrow: I am the LORD.
translations.asv: On the same day it shall be eaten; ye shall leave none of it until the morning: I am Jehovah.
